_comment: Limits for scripts/perf-gate on the Fire TV Stick 4K (release build, dev-mode on, nothing else running). Tighten as the app improves; loosen only with a reason in the commit.
_why: 2026-10-12 (P122): jank is judged as deadline-missed frames, not gfxinfo's janky %, which also counts on-time frames of the Top Shelf's autoplay as high input latency. 2 % = 1 frame in 50; measured on master: dock 1.3-1.6 %, grid 0.2-1.1 %. p90 is reported, not judged.
_dockP99: 2026-10-20 (P245): the dock route judges p99 at 31 ms, the grid keeps 25. Over a 2x-interleaved bisect the dock's median-of-3 p99 read 25-31 ms on every build, the known-good ea491f70 included (26, 30), so 25 failed the baseline itself. The dock reads p99 from 3-4 frames per sample, so a single slow frame moves it. Deadline-missed % stays the dock's judged jank metric. Lower this when the dock's p99 drops.
_dock: 2026-10-13 (P122): the dock route's PSS limit is 135 MB, the grid keeps 120. On the dock the Top Shelf's Cover Flow and scene stay resident; HWUI's GPU caches hold ~39 MB there (34 MB purgeable). Trimming them would bring re-upload hitches back, and smoothness comes first (user). 2026-10-13: raised to 145 MB. The dock's PSS depends on what the Top Shelf shows (measured 131-146 MB the same day on one build), the pre-P119 build 0be5053 already read 141 MB (P119, A1 and the browser link add ~2 MB), trimming the Cover Flow preview pool 10->6 MB changed nothing, and the peak is GL mtrack (~44 MB of GPU layers and textures), which we don't trim.
_apk: 2026-10-20 (P92 step 7): a ratchet, not the target. master's release APK is 5,788,484 bytes; the user-approved target is 5.0 MB. Lower this as the APK shrinks; raise it only with the reason in the commit.
_macrobench: 2026-10-20: frameDurationCpuMs P90 and startup TTID, from the bench on e0168f23. Where the approved budget is met it is the limit (startupCold 900, startupWarm 350, focusGrid 10, appLaunch 16); where not, measured P90 +~15% as a ratchet (rowScroll 17.4, focusDock 21.1, controlCenterWarm 36.2, appSwitcher 27.0, appMenu 26.3). P99 is reported, not judged: it moves ±20 ms between runs and appLaunch's includes the first-launch warm-up. Lower these as the app improves.
